intro.text: A wealthy man of the Rose Empire, known only from a letter Shai forged in the Bloodsealer's name.

items.text: Shai's letter, written to look like the Bloodsealer's and meant to turn her guards against him, described Azalec as famous in Dzhamar for making a fortune in the empire's Southern Provinces. She worked hard to make it convincing, so the detail is probably true.
